public_body: Somerset Board Of Water And Sewer Commissioners
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by taking unanimous votes at a remote-participation meeting without roll calls, and declined to review the screening-committee allegations.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board did not take roll call votes at its April 29, 2020 meeting, where all three members participated remotely.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, because the Board failed to conduct roll call votes during the April 29 meeting, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a preliminary screening committee failed to post meeting notices and keep minutes; the complainant conceded the point after the Board argued no committee existed.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we do not review this portion of the complaint.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the screening committee forwarded only one final candidate for a foreman position and the Board accepted that candidate without public interviews.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, because the Superintendent assembled individuals on his own, was not directed to do so by the Board, and the Board never voted to create a preliminary screening committee, there was no committee subject to the Open Meeting Law and the Board did not violate the law by accepting the one final candidate.

remedy: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
